- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.0), model tends to under-forecast; increase forecast slightly to align with upward momentum.  
- When sentiment is negative (≤ -0.1), model tends to over-forecast; reduce forecast to match downward pressure.  
- Model consistently overreacts to recent spikes; cap forecast peaks at 1.5–2x recent high to avoid overshoot.  
- Model underestimates mean reversion in 30-day horizon; add 0.5–1.0% buffer to forecast if recent 7-day average is below 30-day average.  
- Forecast lag is consistent: model often misses 1–2 days of true trend; adjust by adding 0.5–1.0% to forecast for each lagged day.  
- In 30-day horizon, model frequently fails to capture sentiment-driven momentum; weight sentiment by 15–20% in final forecast adjustment.
